resources.string: Several changes in one pass: the file is encoded once.
Changed from the set: Save set keeps it under a name.
Never enlarged: files already this small stay as they are.
Small files; a file already in H.265 isn\'t encoded again unless its picture changes.
No visible difference, files about twice the size of saving.
Plays on every phone, TV and Chromecast; bigger files.
Interlacing and black bars are measured per file in the preview; files without them skip that part.
Tracks with damaged frames become AAC; the others are copied.
Every track becomes AAC with even loudness (quiet dialogue, loud music).
Holds everything: all tracks, subtitles and fonts.
Plays most widely; image subtitles and fonts are dropped.
Order: sound fix and deinterlace first, then crop, scale and codec; audio additions; container last. A step a file doesn\'t need is skipped for that file.
Turn on at least one step.
It appears under Start from on every phone; a set with the same name is replaced.
